meta_description: Stylish Walls is a Liverpool painter and decorator offering interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full room transformations. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Liverpool Painter & Decorator — Free Quotes
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full room makeovers, Stylish Walls delivers quality finishes that last. Serving Liverpool for over a decade.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: Whether you need a fresh coat of paint, bespoke wallpapering, or a complete room transformation, we deliver meticulous results on time and on budget.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and built-ins painted to a flawless finish. We prep thoroughly, use premium paints, and protect your furniture and floors throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered walls. We use trade-grade materials and work around your schedule with minimal disruption.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert hanging of patterned paper, textured finishes, and contemporary wall coverings. Precise measurements and invisible seams every time.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Bold colour choices and statement walls that define a room. We advise on colour psychology and test samples before committing to the full project.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Work
services.desc: Filling, sanding, patching, and priming are done properly — the foundation of any premium finish. We don't cut corners on prep, even on tight budgets.

services.title: Commercial & Residential Refresh
services.desc: Full-scale redecorating for homes, rental properties, offices, and retail spaces. We work flexibly around your tenancy or business hours.

about_pullquote: I started Stylish Walls because I'd seen too many botched decorating jobs. We do it right.
about_para_1: Stylish Walls was founded in 2012 by a decorating craftsman who was tired of watching cowboys ruin properties across Liverpool. Today, we've transformed over 500 homes and commercial spaces with meticulous attention to detail, quality materials, and honest pricing. Every team member is trained in our standards — no shortcuts, no surprises.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on showing up on time, protecting your home while we work, and delivering a finish that looks as good in year three as it does on day one. We listen to what you want, advise on colour and style, and give you a fixed quote before we lift a brush. Repeat customers and referrals make up 70% of our work — that's how we know we're getting it right.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Stylish Walls

reviews.text: We had the whole lounge repainted and a feature wall done. The lads were tidy, polite, and the finish is absolutely brilliant. They moved furniture, covered everything, and cleaned up properly at the end. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Got three quotes for wallpapering our hallway. Stylish Walls came in at a fair price and the workmanship is flawless. You can't see the seams and the pattern lines up perfectly. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Catherine B.

reviews.text: Had them back for the third time to do our daughter's bedroom. They always turn up when they say they will, treat your home with respect, and never pressure you into extras. Fair pricing and top-quality work. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: David L.
